katanaHook.summary: Three Hails redistributes one neutral three-beat budget: 0.85x, 0.85x, then 1.30x.
Continuations landed inside a narrow cadence window gain edge damage.
Each continued beat adds a storm stack; the chain reset clears the weave.
The final beat carries the wielder through a short rift and lands harder.
Every continued beat lengthens the edge's effective horizon.
Recovery is faster but ordinary beats lose edge; the finisher punishes tough targets.
The sixth beat breaks its stored moonwake in a close lunar burst.
A perfectly timed continuation gains a brief guard window and a modest edge bonus.
Three measuring cuts build reach; the fourth releases an extreme execution multiplier.
